title: Sum of signed linear-form terms
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a_1,\\ldots,a_n$ be real numbers, and let $x$ be a point in the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The sum over $i=1,\\ldots,n$ of $a_i$ times the $i$th sign coordinate of $x$ equals the linear form $\\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real number to each coordinate
